reason_codes.title: Other Fraud - Card-Absent Environment
required_evidence: Two or more prior undisputed transactions settled 120 to 365 calendar days before the disputed transaction
Match on at least 2 of 4 core elements (IP Address, Device ID, Account ID, Shipping Address)
At least 1 matching element must be IP Address or Device ID / Fingerprint
Proof of delivery or digital service access logs tied to the disputed order
optional_supporting_evidence: AVS and CVV match response codes from authorization log
Customer support emails confirming account ownership
3D Secure authentication data if applicable
common_rejection_reasons: Historical transactions fall outside the 120 to 365 day window
Only Account ID and Shipping Address match without IP or Device ID
Historical transaction was itself disputed or refunded for fraud

reason_codes.title: Merchandise / Services Not Received
required_evidence: Proof of delivery (carrier tracking with delivery date and destination matching order)
For digital goods or SaaS: server access logs showing IP, timestamp, and account activity after purchase
Itemized order invoice with billing and shipping addresses
optional_supporting_evidence: Signed proof of delivery or GPS delivery photo
Email or chat communication where customer acknowledges receipt
Shipping policy disclosed at checkout
common_rejection_reasons: Tracking number shows in-transit or label-created instead of delivered
Delivery address city or postal code does not match the cardholder order
No usage logs provided for digital or SaaS delivery

reason_codes.title: Cancelled Recurring Transaction
required_evidence: Proof that cardholder agreed to recurring billing terms at checkout
Proof that cancellation request was not received prior to the billing date or did not follow disclosed cancellation policy
Records showing continued service access after the disputed billing date
optional_supporting_evidence: Pre-renewal email notification logs with delivery timestamps
Account settings audit log showing subscription remained active
Support ticket history
common_rejection_reasons: Cancellation policy was buried and not clearly presented at checkout
Customer emailed to cancel before renewal and merchant failed to process it
No proof of active usage or renewal notice

reason_codes.title: Not as Described or Defective Merchandise / Services
required_evidence: Product or service description shown to customer at the time of purchase
Evidence refuting the specific defect or mismatch claim (photos, QA logs, feature logs)
Proof that customer did not attempt to return the merchandise or contact support
optional_supporting_evidence: Return and refund policy accepted at checkout
Support conversation offering replacement or troubleshooting
Pre-shipment inspection photos
common_rejection_reasons: Generic rebuttal that does not address the cardholder's specific complaint
No proof of what was advertised on the product page at checkout

reason_codes.title: Credit Not Processed
required_evidence: Refund transaction receipt showing credit was already issued to the same card (ARN / refund ID)
Or refund policy showing the order did not qualify for a refund (e.g. non-refundable item, outside return window)
optional_supporting_evidence: Return shipping tracking showing item was never returned
Email confirming refund processing timeline or store credit agreement
common_rejection_reasons: Refund was issued to store credit without cardholder consent when card refund was promised
Missing Acquirer Reference Number (ARN) for an already-processed refund

reason_codes.title: No Cardholder Authorization
required_evidence: Proof of cardholder link to the transaction (AVS/CVV match, device/IP history, prior undisputed orders)
Proof of delivery to cardholder billing or verified shipping address
3D Secure / Identity Check authentication data if present
optional_supporting_evidence: Account login history and prior non-disputed purchases
Customer support correspondence from the registered email
common_rejection_reasons: Submitting only an invoice without technical authorization or delivery proof
Shipping to a freight forwarder with no prior account history

reason_codes.title: Cardholder Dispute (Defective, Not as Described, Cancelled Recurring, Credit Not Processed)
required_evidence: Evidence directly addressing the sub-reason (product description, cancellation terms, or refund ARN)
Checkout terms and refund/cancellation policy disclosure
Customer communication log showing resolution attempts
optional_supporting_evidence: Service usage logs or QA inspection records
Signed contract or statement of work for B2B services
common_rejection_reasons: Failing to identify which Mastercard 4853 sub-category applies
Missing checkout disclosure screenshots for refund or cancellation terms

reason_codes.title: Goods or Services Not Provided
required_evidence: Carrier tracking confirming delivery to the cardholder's provided address
Or digital delivery logs showing download/access after payment
Order confirmation with itemized goods or services
optional_supporting_evidence: Delivery signature or photo confirmation
Customer communication confirming receipt
common_rejection_reasons: Missing proof of delivery date or destination
Item shipped after the promised delivery date without customer agreement

reason_codes.title: Card Not Present Fraud (F29) / Goods or Services Not Received (C08)
required_evidence: For F29: proof of delivery to cardholder's verified billing address, AVS/CID match, and prior account history
For C08: carrier tracking showing delivery or digital access logs proving service fulfillment
Itemized receipt matching the exact disputed amount
optional_supporting_evidence: SafeKey authentication data
Signed proof of delivery
Direct cardholder email or chat logs
common_rejection_reasons: Missing the shorter 20-day Amex response deadline
Inability to link shipping address to the cardholder for F29 disputes
